Name: Anthro Rabbit Farmer - Fashion Sense (FS)
Author: Arknir27
Description:
[size=3]Play as an anthropomorphic rabbit farmer from [color=#f6b26b]"[/color][/size][color=#f6b26b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UhDsRp0EfbA][size=4]The Mandrake | 2020 SCAD Short Animated Film 🌱[/size][/url][/color][size=3][color=#f6b26b]"[/color]
Commissioned by CFree91. Requires PeacefulEnd's framework, [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969][size=3]Fashion Sense[/size][/url][size=3]. Special thanks to PeacefulEnd.[/size]


[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/994361829675507732/Fashion_Sense.png[/img][/center]


[size=3]Turn into a gentle rabbit with droopy ears and a dashing moustache using the Hand Mirror.
Also includes the "hat" and shirt. 
[/size]
[size=3][b]Hand Mirror Tutorial:[/b]
[/size]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1119402619891351573/1121238543780565042/Rabbit_Farmer_Tutorial.gif[/img]

﻿[b]Shirt:[/b] Rabbit Farmer Top
[b]Hat:[/b] Rabbit Farmer Head (included animated blinks)
Pants are not included, but uses a specific color from the character creation. The hands also require a grey skin-tone.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1119402619891351573/1121235006308765758/image.png[/img]

[b][s]"Silly Rabbit, Trix are for kids!"[/s][/b]
